paper_metadata.title: Simultaneously enhanced strength and ductility of Mg-Zn-Zr-Ca alloy with fully recrystallized ultrafine grained structures

evidence.quote: Fully recrystallized ultrafine grained (UFG) Mg-Zn-Zr-Ca alloy was successfully fabricated by a process including high pressure torsion (HPT) and subsequent rapid annealing treatment.
For comparison, the Z6 (Mg-6.0 wt.% Zn) alloy, which was a simple solution-hardened Mg-Zn alloy without fine precipitates [23], was also HPT processed by 360° and annealed at 300 °C for 1 min.
